sources.name: dgo-v5.pdf

Singleton use; no need for pairwise noncommensurability. Earlier projection-complex machinery accepted as an imported established theorem, not independently reproved.

sources.read_scope: p17 Remark3.7 and p43 Corollary7.2 with its short proof. Gluing context and free-action-only distinction; not used to infer properness/cocompactness from the fast-automorphism corollary.

sources.name: leary-v3.pdf
sources.read_scope: Appendix C pp29–33: convention, Lemma C.2, full Theorem C.4 and proof, subdivision lemmas/propositions and full Theorem C.9/Corollary C.11 proofs. Main load-bearing local/global CAT(0) and strict-cube interfaces.

sources.read_scope: pp1–2 Theorems1/2 and Morse definition; pp4–8 geometric-separation/superlinear-divergence passages and complete Theorem2/Proposition4.1 proof passages. Exact finitely generated ambient/infinite-order virtually cyclic hyperbolically embedded interface checked; not an independent audit of all upstream hyperbolic-embedding theory.
